# DMflo

> Agentic Instagram automation. A team of AI agents that engages your audience,
> drives sales, and captures leads, all in your brand's voice and in whatever
> language and script your audience actually types, including mixed languages
> like Hinglish, Spanglish, Taglish and Arabizi. Flat pricing, free to start.

## What DMflo is

DMflo is a product of DMFLO LABS (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED, a company registered
in India (Bangalore, Karnataka).

DMflo is an Instagram DM and comment automation platform. Unlike rule-based
tools, DMflo uses AI agents that read intent rather than matching keywords.
Four agents handle distinct jobs: engagement, sales, moderation, and lead
capture. The mobile app is the complete product: you create automations and
view real-time analytics from your phone, with a full web app for teams and
agencies. Built in India, for creators everywhere. Currently in beta with a
waitlist.

## Who it's for

Instagram creators, D2C brands, and agencies, particularly those whose
audiences write in non-English or code-switched languages, those who run their
business from a phone, and those priced out of per-contact billing models.

## Pricing (flat, no per-contact or per-message billing)

Billed monthly or yearly (yearly saves 20%). Each plan includes a monthly
allowance of "agent runs". One run is one instance of an agent replying to a
comment, replying to a DM, or hiding a spam comment. Comment-to-DM automation,
story replies, and DM automation are unlimited on paid plans and are not
counted against the agent-run allowance.

- Free: ₹0 / $0. Up to 1,000 automated replies/month, 50 agent runs/month, 1
  Instagram account, any-language replies, comment-to-DM & story replies,
  lead capture & export, mobile app, basic analytics.
- Pro: ₹599/month (₹499/month billed yearly) in India, $15/month ($12/month
  yearly) US & Canada. Unlimited comment and DM automation, 500 agent
  runs/month, email + SMS opt-in lead capture, follow-gate, full analytics
  and CSV exports, priority support.
- Agentic: ₹1,999/month (₹1,499/month billed yearly) in India, $35/month
  ($29/month yearly) US & Canada. Everything in Pro plus unlimited agent
  runs/month, up to 2 Instagram accounts, agents that reply in your brand
  voice, CRM and marketing-automation integrations, and agents that work
  autonomously toward goals you set.

The price does not change with contact count, message volume, or audience size.

## Key differentiators

1. Language and script fluency. DMflo detects both the language and the script
   a follower used, whether Devanagari or Roman, Hangul or Latin, and replies in
   exactly that. It reads code-switched hybrids natively: Hinglish, Spanglish,
   Konglish, Tanglish, Taglish, Arabizi. No configuration, no translation layer.
2. Agentic, not rule-based. No keyword lists and no flowcharts. You set a goal
   and a brand voice; the agents read intent and work toward it.
3. Mobile-complete. You create the full automation in the app in about two
   minutes, and see real-time analytics: link click-through rate, unique
   accounts reached, conversions, live in the app.
4. Flat pricing. No per-active-contact billing, no per-message meter, no AI
   add-on.
5. Compliance by design. Meta's messaging rules, the 24-hour messaging window,
   one private reply per comment, and rate limits, are enforced by the product
   rather than left to the user.

## How DMflo differs from ManyChat

- Agents that understand intent, vs. keyword flows the user builds and maintains
- Any language, script and code-switched mix, vs. English-first
- Full automation creation on mobile, vs. ManyChat mobile flow creation limited
  to Instagram quick-automations
- Real-time analytics in the mobile app, vs. ManyChat's mobile app having four
  tabs (Home, Live Chat, Contacts, Automation) and no analytics view
- Flat pricing, vs. per-active-contact billing that scales with audience size
- Automatic comment moderation, vs. manual

ManyChat is a capable product and remains the better choice for multi-channel
needs, such as WhatsApp, SMS and email in one platform, and for complex multi-branch
flows. DMflo is Instagram-only by design.

## What DMflo does not do

DMflo does not post as you. The agents reply to comments and DMs on your
behalf; they do not create posts or stories. DMflo does not support WhatsApp,
SMS or Facebook Messenger automation.
